newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE TO DIVEST ALL SANDS SHARES.
newsitem.headline: NESTE TO DIVEST ALL SANDS SHARES.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it sold 3.5 million shares in Swedish Sands Petrolem AB, and that it would sell all its remaining four million shares on October 18.
The 7.5 million B-series shares held by Neste's Swedish arm Neste Sverige AB corresponded to 18.5 percent of votes in Sands.
"After these two transactions, Neste will not own any shares in Sands Petroleum," Neste said in a statement to the Stockholm bourse.
The statement did not give the price of the deal, nor did it say who the buyer was or why the shares were sold.
At Neste headquarters in Espoo, a spokeswoman said information about the divestment of the stake in Sands would be included in the group's January-August report due on October 11.
